title: Understanding Star Schema
text: In a star schema, the dimension tables are used to describe the attributes of the data stored in the fact tables. Think about how these tables might relate to each other.

hintAnswer: To describe attributes of the data in fact tables
title: Role of Dimension Tables
text: What is the primary role of dimension tables in a star schema?
choices: To describe attributes of the data in fact tables

title: Fact Tables in Star Schema
text: Fact tables in a star schema typically contain quantitative data. Consider what kind of information might be stored in these tables.

title: Content of Fact Tables
text: What type of data do fact tables usually contain in a star schema?

title: Relationships in Star Schema
text: In a star schema, relationships are not stored in dimension tables. Think about where these relationships might be represented instead.

hintAnswer: In the structure of the schema itself
title: Where are Relationships Stored?
text: Where are the relationships between different facts typically represented in a star schema?
choices: In the structure of the schema itself
